items.exampleEn: Doctors are learning more about this rare syndrome.
items.exampleZh: 醫生對這種罕見的症候群了解得越來越多。

items.exampleEn: Some animals can heal very quickly.

items.exampleZh: 這次訓練讓每個人都累了。

items.exampleEn: The hotel has rooms for disabled guests.
items.exampleZh: 這家飯店有給身障旅客的房間。

items.exampleEn: Laughter is the best cure for a bad day.
items.exampleZh: 笑是治療壞心情的最佳良方。

items.exampleEn: We had chicken liver for dinner.
You can see the blue veins on the back of your hand.
items.exampleZh: 你可以看到手背上的藍色血管。

items.exampleEn: People in the village still use old remedies made from plants.
items.exampleZh: 村裡的人仍然使用用植物做的老偏方。

items.sentenceEn: Regular workouts keep my father strong.
items.sentenceZh: 規律的鍛鍊讓我爸爸保持強壯。

items.audioEn: The new gym is open twenty-four hours, and the first workout is free.
items.audioZh: 新健身房二十四小時營業，第一次訓練免費。

items.sentenceEn: Doctors hope to find a cure for this disease one day.
items.sentenceZh: 醫生希望有一天能找到治癒這種疾病的方法。

items.sentenceEn: Many disabled athletes take part in this race.
items.sentenceZh: 許多身障運動員參加這場比賽。

items.stemEn: Blood goes back to the heart through the ____.
items.stemZh: 血液經由靜脈流回心臟。

items.stemEn: It took three weeks for the cut on his leg to ____.
items.stemZh: 他腿上的傷口花了三個星期才癒合。

items.passageEn: Ella runs a small gym for older people and disabled people. Each workout is short and simple. One of her members has a rare syndrome that makes his muscles weak. There is no cure, but he enjoys the classes and has made many friends there. Ella also collects old books about home remedies from different countries. Many members arrive by public transport, so she chose a place near the station.
items.passageZh: Ella 經營一家給長者和身障者的小健身房。每次的訓練都很短又簡單。她的一位會員患有一種罕見的症候群，讓他的肌肉無力。這種病無法治癒，但他很喜歡上課，也在那裡交了很多朋友。Ella 也收集來自各國、講居家偏方的舊書。許多會員搭大眾運輸來，所以她把地點選在車站附近。

questions.questionZh: Ella 的健身房是為誰開的？
Ella 為什麼把地點選在車站附近？
options: 那裡有很多的停車位可用

items.promptZh: 肝臟每天幫身體做很多工作。
referenceEn: The liver does a lot of work for the body every day.
Every day, the liver does many jobs for the body.
rubricZh: 主詞與動詞一致（例如 the liver does、our livers do 等）
時態配合內容（多用現在簡單式）

rubricZh: 用 workout 表示「健身；鍛鍊」
